item.description: A male worker has died from his injuries after being attacked inside a crocodile enclosure at Adventure Park at Port Moresby on Saturday afternoon. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Aussie Patterson claims Diamond League Final title with 'insane' win
item.description: Eleanor Patterson continues her outstanding season by winning the women's high jump at the Diamond League Final in Brussels. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Luke Pentony

item.title: 50 years of spotting southern right whales off Great Australian Bight
item.description: From WA's capital to SA's far west coast, scientists have collated 50 years' worth of data on the southern right whale to track changes to breeding cycles. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jenae Madden and Emma Pedler

item.title: Sweeny exits US Open to end Australia's singles chances
item.description: Australia's last US Open singles hope is eliminated, with gallant wildcard Dane Sweeny suffering a third-round loss to Italian 21st seed Luciano Darderi. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Old working dogs refuse to be put out to pasture
item.description: Arthritis and other ailments cannot stop these faithful companions, who are still pulling their weight on farming properties. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Mark Bennett

item.title: Cutting cigarette tax will not create more smokers, Angus Taylor says
item.description: The opposition leader says slashing the tax on a pack of cigarettes by more than $20 will not lead to more smokers, as the cost of illegal cigarettes is already at that price. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Labor commits $550m for freeway upgrade in Melbourne's outer west
item.description: A key section of freeway linking some of Melbourne's fastest-growing areas will be upgraded, with $550 million in state government money joining a $1 billion Commonwealth pledge. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Negotiations over 'Australia's biggest shortcut' near an end
item.description: Years of complex land access negotiations with multiple traditional owner groups appear to be nearing an end, paving the way for the sealing of an outback highway dubbed "Australia's biggest shortcut". Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Germany's Isar rocket launches from arctic Norway and reaches orbit
item.description: Germany's Isar Aerospace launches a rocket into orbit from Norway as Europe races to boost its ability to send satellites into space. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Meet the Rural Women's Award finalists for 2026
item.description: Australia's Rural Woman of the Year will be announced in Canberra on Tuesday, September 8. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Justine Longmore and Annie Brown

item.title: Hawkesbury's Helping Hands charity marks 15 years of service
item.description: What began as a mother and daughter providing some home-cooked meals in plastic containers has grown into a charity with a warehouse that provides hampers and basic essentials for hundreds of people across Sydney's most disaster-prone region. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Declan Bowring

item.title: Perth looks back to the day when Mundaring Weir last overflowed
item.description: Thirty years ago, Perth's Mundaring Weir overflowed following good winter rains. The visitors who flocked to see the spectacle had no idea it would never happen again. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Emma Wynne and Natalie Jones

item.title: Social media platforms to be forced to offer algorithm opt-out
item.description: Social media companies would be required to give users a choice to turn off their algorithm through pop-up messages, under draft laws to be unveiled by the government later this week. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: David Speers

item.title: Indigenous dads challenging stereotypes this Father's Day
item.description: Indigenous fathers say damaging stereotypes continue to shape how they are seen as parents, as advocates call for their strengths and contributions to families to be celebrated this Father's Day. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Chris Murrkarany Fitzpatrick

item.title: 'Illuminated temple' lost to fire was a remnant of Tasmania's hydro boom
item.description: Unless you have a connection to Hydro Tasmania, there is a good chance this week was the first time you had ever heard of Tungatinah Power Station. Nestled beside the Nive River in Tasmania's Central Highlands, the hydro-electric power station was destroyed by a fire on Wednesday night — with the cause of the blaze still unknown. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Crystal McKay

item.title: It doesn't look dangerous, but this sneaky snail causes enormous damage
item.description: The Drupella snail doesn't look threatening, but it is such a danger to Queensland's reefs that tourism operators have helped cull hundreds of thousands of them as part of a management plan. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Johanna Marie and Grace Whiteside

item.title: The ACT's 99-year leases are expiring — what does that mean for home owners?
item.description: The ACT is the only jurisdiction in Australia that operates under a leasehold system, meaning every home owner is actually a lessor. With the first of those leases coming up for renewal, there are questions about the leasing system's origin and ongoing relevance. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Niki Burnside

item.title: The 100 Project preserves history of Australia's centenarians
item.description: Bek Hyland says her late 106-year-old grandma, Merle Moore, was incredibly grateful to the project for helping to preserve the story of her life. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Sarah Moss

item.title: Calls to preserve largest Australian World War II prison camp
item.description: The camp housed Italian, German and Japanese prisoners between 1941 and 1947 and a portion of the former site is now on the market. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Mangelsdorf

item.title: Proposal to pump 70m litres of treated wastewater into Parramatta River
item.description: If approved, a Sydney facility will pump millions of litres of treated wastewater, equivalent to 35 Olympic-sized swimming pools, into Parramatta River per day to service a growing population. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: The 'loyal foot soldiers' who sought to reshape the NSW Liberal Party
item.description: Take a look inside the workings of the right-wing Liberal faction at the centre of NSW ICAC's Operation Rosny. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: An Egyptian court sentenced a well-known television presenter and 11 others to death for manufacturing and trafficking narcotics in a sprawling drugs case, official media reported on Saturday. The presenter, Sarah Khalifa, 39, is best known for her programme Mission Impossible, which dealt with issues concerning security and crime. The state-linked Al-Ahram newspaper said a Cairo court sentenced “Khalifa and 11 other defendants to death by hanging on charges of forming an organised criminal gang... Publicado también por: South China Morning Post, The Times of India - World, ABC News Australia. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: Crime gangs use bots to lure young men in sextortion scams
item.description: Criminal gangs continue to have Australian men and boys in their sights as targets for sexual extortion, with more than $200,000 defrauded from victims in one state. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Scientists optimistic despite losing 14,000 tagged bogong moths
item.description: Scientists tagged thousands of bogong moths using paper and eyelash glue in an attempt to track their flight path. Now they cannot find a single one. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Council tries regulating smart glasses but experts say it needs a heavier touch
item.description: Brisbane City Council banned the use of smart glasses at public pools, but experts say the issue is beyond the power of local councils. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Lagging fire response in outer Melbourne poses 'risk to community safety'
item.description: Residents in growth areas of Melbourne are experiencing worsening responses to fire emergencies, an ABC analysis of Fire Rescue Victoria data has found. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
